svg.text: Lane V, part 2 — the receive pipeline, the application, and the node image
Task groups 1.4 and 1.5. Three stages written independently, then composed.
The image also waits on the shared codec pin
(11.1.1.1) and on the image CI lane (5.1.8.2) —
for a container image, that lane is the whole
closed — verified by a green CI lane
